---
title: "Course template"
---

Starter files for a new course website. Copy this directory to
`courses/<slug>/` and rename placeholders.

## Files

- `_quarto.yml` — course-level Quarto website configuration
- `index.qmd` — course landing page
- `metadata.yaml` — machine-readable course descriptor

## Expected surrounding structure

```
courses/<slug>/
  _quarto.yml
  index.qmd
  metadata.yaml
  glossary.qmd
  part-1/
    index.qmd
    01-<lesson-slug>/
      index.qmd
      exercise.qmd
      lab.qmd
      quiz.qmd
      summary.qmd
      assets/
  labs/
  assets/
```

The reference implementation is [`courses/pico/`](../../courses/pico/).

## OELS authoring

A new course copied from this template inherits the shared Open
Engineering Language Server (OELS) authoring contract without any
per-course configuration file, absolute path, or committed dependency.
See the **OELS authoring integration** section of
[`templates/README.qmd`](../README.qmd) for what OELS treats as an OE
resource, how to run it locally over stdio without hardcoded paths, how
its diagnostics differ from Quarto render errors, and troubleshooting.
No change to `_quarto.yml`, `index.qmd`, or `metadata.yaml` is required
by that contract today.
